dataSheets.name: Analyse scope
dataSheets.note: Event volume by platform (rows) and event type (columns). Blank cells mean no events of that type were seen on the platform.

dataSheets.name: App Versions
dataSheets.note: App versions carried by the tracking events in the capture window: 10,000 of 10,000 events on device channels. SDK version is ua_sdk_version on the same device event. Events with no app version are absent from this sheet: API-fed data, which carries no device, and web channels.

dataSheets.name: Absent from latest version
dataSheets.note: Likely no longer tracked in the latest app build — Custom events: 2. Only SDK (on-device) data carries app versions, so API-only data is never flagged.
